transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, August 15. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Four losses already, nine Tests left: What India need to do to reach WTC final?. "The main goal is to play the WTC final, which is next year. And we have got about nine Tests and I think we have to win around six or seven to be able to have a good chance at qualifying. So in terms of that, I think it's a very important series for us," India captain Gill said at the pre-match press conference ahead of first Test against Sri Lanka on Saturday. MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work. MacKenzie Scott is leading the charge in medical debt relief, having made groundbreaking donations that freed over $40 billion for families burdened by this often overwhelming responsibility. Her innovative approach, which involves acquiring debt at minimal costs for cancellation, has inspired other billionaires to make similar contributions. Yet, the call for broader policy reform lingers, revealing the constraints of this philanthropic model. Happy Independence Day 2026: Wishes, Messages, quotes, images, Facebook and WhatsApp status. With the 80th Independence Day on the horizon, India stands poised for a time of reflection and celebration of its rich heritage. With these wishes and messages, it's a chance to unite, reaffirm our commitment to progress, and cherish the liberty that was earnestly fought for. 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes off Indonesia coast; tsunami alert issued. A 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia's Flores region early Saturday, prompting a tsunami warning for parts of East Nusa Tenggara, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS). Gandhi's letter to India, as told through TOI. From his South Africa years to the freedom struggle, Mahatma Gandhi repeatedly used newspapers to address India's public. Alok Sharma sifts through letters Gandhi wrote to TOI, illuminating his positions on Satyagraha, the Rowlatt Act, Dalit representation, Hindu Trump claims he will soon declare Strait of Hormuz a US territory; Iran hits back. US President Donald Trump Friday said the United States will soon declare the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz a territory of the US, escalating his rhetoric over the waterway at the centre of the ongoing conflict with Iran. Oracle prepares fresh layoffs before September 1, asks managers to name who goes. Oracle is planning fresh layoffs this month, with managers reportedly asked to identify employees whose roles will go before its second fiscal quarter opens on September 1. Some teams face double-digit percentage cuts. The move follows a year in which Oracle eliminated 21,000 jobs, spent $1.8 billion on restructuring, and poured $55.7 billion into AI data centres. CJI, Nalsar students have one query for BCI: 'Who are you?'. NEW DELHI: Supreme Court on Friday castigated the Bar Council of India (BCI) for threatening to deny licence to practice to Hyderabad-based NALSAR university students who opposed CJI Surya Kant as their convocation chief guest, shielded them against coercive action, and offered the law graduates a start as legal aid counsel in SC. 'Our blood has been sucked': J and K CM Omar hits back at Pak PM Shehbaz over IWT. SRINAGAR: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif warned at an event in Islamabad on Friday that Pakistan would take any step to protect its water rights under the Indus Waters Treaty, saying "every single drop" of Pakistan's water is a "red line" and "India must come to the right path" or it would "be given a direct response". Indian-origin man rejected for H-1B 3 times finds another way to stay in US. Sohan Sethi faced multiple H-1B visa rejections after arriving in the United States. He then pursued an O-1 visa, requiring extensive documentation and lawyer fees. Sethi demonstrated extraordinary ability through achievements and industry recognition to secure his stay. This path highlights the challenges faced by skilled professionals seeking to remain in America. Zohran Mamdani's 'common sense regulation' may push Amazon to move NYC deliveries. In a bold move, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has shown support for a groundbreaking bill that mandates direct employment for delivery drivers, aiming to eliminate subcontracting and bolster the rights of workers. However, Amazon has raised concerns, indicating the bill may drive its operations outside of the city. 'First Islamic republic with nuclear weapons': Netanyahu lashes out at UK. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has launched a sharp rebuke against the UK, calling it the "Islamic republic of Britain" and describing it as a potential "first Islamic republic with nuclear weapons" in a podcast interview.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal I-Day Parade: Check Traffic Diversions, Restricted Routes And Parking Arrangements. Traffic police have announced diversions and parking arrangements for Independence Day celebrations at Lal Parade Ground on August 15. MP School Uniform Row: 56.6 Lakh Students Await Dresses Ahead Of Independence Day. Government school students have been advised to attend Independence Day celebrations in prescribed uniforms, but 56,62,228 Class 1-8 students are reportedly still awaiting dresses. IAS Officer Neha Marvya Faces Staff Protest In Bhopal Over Alleged Misbehaviour And Threats. Officers and employees of the Tribal Area Development Programme staged a pen-down strike and protested against director IAS officer Neha Marvya on Friday. Bhopal BMC Meeting: Opposition To Raise Illegal Commercial Activities, Waterlogging And Bad Roads. Illegal commercial activities in residential areas, poor roads and rain-related waterlogging are expected to dominate the BMC Council meeting on August 19. NHRC Questions Regulatory Basis Of 'Analogue Paneer', Seeks Nationwide Details On Sales And Safety. An NHRC bench led by Priyank Kanoongo has sought clarity on the manufacture, sale and consumption of 'analogue paneer', including its composition, nutrition and food safety. DRI busts international drug syndicate in Bhopal and Greater Noida, arrests four Nigerians. Indore Fire Department Adds Four Compact Fire Bikes To Reach Narrow Lanes During Emergencies. Four high-tech fire bikes have been added to the city's firefighting fleet to tackle emergencies in narrow lanes and crowded markets. Why Two Madhya Pradesh Temples Celebrate Independence Day On 11 August. Grand Tricolour Rally held in Bhopal under Har Ghar Tiranga campaign. Woman dies as wall collapses in Rewa village. State's First 14-D Theatre At Indore Zoo, Nehru Park Pool To Open On August 16. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav will inaugurate a 14-D theatre at Indore Zoo and a new swimming pool at Nehru Park on August 16. New Six-Lane Expressway May Cut Bhopal-Indore Travel Time By Half. Madhya Pradesh High Court Urges Centre, State To Bridge rupees 1 Crore Gap For Child's Rare Disease Treatment. Bhopal To Indore In 2 Hours? 160-Km Expressway With 6 Lanes To Cut Travel Time By Half. Physical Search For Missing Techie Advait Upadhyay Called Off; Police Turn To Digital Trail. Police have called off the physical search for 32-year-old cybersecurity professional Advait Upadhyay, who went missing from Karnataka's Shivagange Hill on August 7. CM leads Tiranga yatra in Bhopal, marks Partition Horrors Day. MP HC orders state-wide probe into paddy scam. Ujjain School Relocation Row: 300-Plus Girls Stage Protest Against Shifting Sarafa School To Daudkhedi. More than 300 girls from Government Sarafa School staged a protest at the Collectorate against the proposed relocation of their school to Daudkhedi, around 8 km away. Father, son die of electrocution while spraying pesticide in Bilkhiria field. Stung 200 times, 40 injured: Bees attack BJP's Tiranga Yatra in Madhya Pradesh's Dewas.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Jane Street Lost $15 Billion in Its First Down Month in a Decade. Jane Street posted roughly $15 billion of losses in July , its first monthly slump in about a decade , as AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness swooned and dragged down asset prices across equity markets, according to a person familiar with the matter. Binance Research: Gen Z Leads Net Accumulation Across Every TradFi Product. Mumbai (Maharashtra) , August 14: Binance Research, the market research arm of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange Binance, has recently published a new weekly market commentary titled 'Gen Z Perspective Rewrite'. The report examines how Gen Z users behave across three TradFi products, namely, direct equities, bStocks, and TradFi-Perps, and finds behavior that is more disciplined and allocation-oriented than common assumptions suggest. Institutional investors reveal cautious approach to tech favorites in US quarterly 13F filings. USA-MARKETS/13F-OVERVIEW (GRAPHIC, PIX):Institutional investors reveal cautious approach to tech favorites in US quarterly 13F filings A well-designed regulatory ecosystem can further strengthen service exports and ease of doing business, says NITI Aayog. Powered by Capital Market Oil prices rally, US data dents chances of Fed rate hike. GLOBAL-MARKETS:Oil prices rally, US data dents chances of Fed rate hike Nifty closing gap narrows two weeks after CAS rollout, Sensex stays higher. The difference between the Nifty's level at the start of the closing auction and its final close has narrowed, while the corresponding gap in the Sensex remains marginally higher Oil Rises as US Warns of More Economic Pressure to Isolate Iran. Oil edged higher as traders weighed a US threat to impose unprecedented economic measures on Iran, with the war that snarled the Strait of Hormuz in its sixth month. Svatantra Microfin files papers with Sebi for rupees 3,000 crore public offer. The proposed IPO comprises a fresh issue and an offer for sale of rupees 1,500 crore each; fresh proceeds will be used to augment the microfinance lender's Tier Dollar falls on surprise drop in US retail sales. GLOBAL-FOREX:Dollar falls on surprise drop in US retail sales Patanjali Foods shares to be in focus on Monday as Q1 net profit jumps 86 percent ; revenue hits record. Patanjali Foods reported a robust June-quarter performance, with net profit increasing by 86 percent YoY to rupees 335.73 crore and the highest-ever revenue of rupees 11,337.45 crore. A 40 percent interim dividend has also been declared for FY27. Alphabet's $900 million SpaceX bet soars to $94 billion after rocket firm's IPO, filings show. Alphabet's $900 million investment in SpaceX is now worth about $94 billion, making it the rocket firm's largest reported institutional holder after its IPO, filings show. Bazel International consolidated net profit rises 85.71 percent in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 16.35 percent to rupees 1.21 crore Sebi proposes overhaul of settlement rules to cut amounts, speed enforcement. A proposed formula could halve the gap between settlement amounts and final penalties, while fast-track rules aim to resolve cases sooner York Exports reports consolidated net loss of rupees 1.52 crore in the June 2026 quarter. Sales decline 40.48 percent to rupees 3.22 crore SC slaps fine on RIL over NTPC gas supply suit. The Supreme Court fined Reliance Industries ten lakh rupees for delaying a suit. Gold jumps 9 percent in August as weaker dollar, easing Fed bets boost demand. Gold prices are on a winning streak as US Fed rate hike expectations ease and a weaker dollar boosts overseas demand. Spot gold reached $4,397 an ounce, marking a 9 percent monthly gain in August, while remaining below January's all-time high of $5,602. Free dhaniya no more? Kitchens feel a new squeeze. Coriander prices have surged significantly after heavy rains disrupted essential vegetable supplies. Reddit shares jump 15 percent as social media platform set to join S and P 500. Reddit shares jumped 15 percent to $181.7 after being added to the S and P 500 next week, replacing AvalonBay Communities. The inclusion acknowledges Reddit's significant market cap of $30 billion and aligns with its strong performance, boasting an eighth consecutive quarter of sales growth. FCNR(B) window to close early after strong show. The Reserve Bank of India has closed its special forex swap facility early. Sebi proposes easier digital KYC for Indians living abroad. Sebi's proposed overhaul would let NRIs, OCIs and eligible foreign nationals complete securities-market KYC digitally from abroad, easing onboarding and document-verification hurdles. Mitsubishi to pay NTPC rupees 851 cr for project exit. Mitsubishi is nearing an exit from NTPC's Farakka power project. US stocks mixed after weak retail sales data, Reddit jumps 14.7 percent , Middle East in focus. As of 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 was virtually unchanged, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down less than 0.1 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite was 0.2 percent lower. Moksh Ornaments standalone net profit rises 28.10 percent in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 77.64 percent to rupees 267.63 crore Sugar stock scrutiny on rise as prices hit roofs. The government is increasing scrutiny of sugar stocks due to surging prices. Dollar deluge prompts RBI to shut special FCNR scheme early; $52 bn raised so far. The decision to close the special scheme comes just a week after RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra said there was no plan for a premature closure Karnavati Finance reports standalone net profit of rupees 6.25 crore in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 745.45 percent to rupees 1.86 crore Badal attack: Accused blamed SAD for drug crisis. The individual accused of attacking Sukhbir Singh Badal has placed the blame on the escalating drug crisis in Punjab, asserting that the former SAD government did little to resolve the issue. Pulse of the Street: Tata jitters, metal rout weigh on Indian equities. Indian equities fell 0.8 percent this week as Tata succession uncertainty and a sell-off in metals outweighed gains in telecom and realty stocks, leaving India behind a broader AI-led rally across Asia. Galaxy Supermarket reports standalone net loss of rupees 0.46 crore in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 15.27 percent to rupees 12.23 crore Iranian prez to visit India for BRICS summit. In September, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian will be in Delhi for the 18th BRICS summit, a visit set against the backdrop of heightened US-Iran tensions and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Actor Ajay Devgn, mother to earn rupees 16 lakh/month from Juhu bungalow lease - check Juhu Road property price trends. Juhu is one of the top localities in Mumbai by property prices too. The average asking price here is rupees 45,000 per sq. ft. The data further shows that property prices in the Juhu Road micromarket have shown a steady growth over the last year, according to Square Yards data. Sebi proposes major overhaul of settlement rules; fast-track route for cases up to rupees 10 lakh. The proposals include removing an additional 20 percent settlement charge in certain cases involving multiple proceedings and introducing a fast-track mechanism for settlements of up to rupees 10 lakh Can NRIs invest in National Savings Certificate (NSC) and avail tax benefits?. The National Saving Certificate (NSC) is one of the popular small savings schemes among Indians investors with a low-risk appetite as the scheme is backed by the government and offers an attractive interest rate of 7.7 percent . The NSC scheme is available only to resident citizens of India. West Bengal to implement Ayushman Bharat, Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana from August 16 , Here's all we know. West Bengal government is set to implement the Centre's health insurance scheme Ayushman Bharat and state's cashless coverage scheme Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana from August 16. Here's all we know... Husband with rupees 11,000/month income ordered to pay rupees 25,000 monthly maintenance to wife, child with 5 percent annual increase; here's what Delhi HC said. The husband said his salary hasn't grown since his job began and claimed to earn just rupees 11,000 a month despite a UK hospitality degree, but Delhi HC wasn't convinced. The court ruled that the maintenance paid to wife and son must rise 5 percent annually to beat inflation, rejecting a husband's claim of limited income. 8th Pay Commission: Eligibility criteria, essential qualifications for consultants; check what's changed. The 8th Pay Commission has updated guidelines on eligibility criteria and essential qualifications for vacancies of its contract-based consultant roles. Here's a look at what has changed for the applicants. 8th Pay Commission update: Inclusion of revision of pension and family pension in 8th CPC terms of reference demanded by central govt employee and pensioner bodies. 8th Pay Commission latest news: Pensioner and employee bodies are advocating for the revision of pensions for those who retired before 2026 under the 8th Pay Commission. They are also pressing to eliminate the 'unfunded cost' provision from the commission's guidelines. Both the Bharat Pensioners' Samaj and AIDEF, representing millions of central government retirees, are calling for immediate government intervention to ensure fair and equitable pension benefits for all. 'Think early retirement is boring? Try...': Pro-FIRE user's post sparks debate; social media reacts. Finance commentator Seb's FIRE Journey ignites online debate over early retirement versus corporate life. Many agree that a lengthy commute and dull meetings can overshadow the perceived boredom of retirement. Up to 7.25 percent senior citizen FD interest rate: What is the maturity amount on rupees 5 lakh in 5-year SBI, PNB, HDFC Bank and other FDs?. For senior citizens seeking consistent returns, fixed deposits present an appealing option. Notably, Axis Bank currently leads the market with a striking interest rate of 7.25 percent for a five-year term. A rupees 5 lakh investment could mature to around rupees 7.16 lakh after five years. Other prominent banks such as SBI and ICICI Bank also offer competitive rates, while HDFC Bank comes in with the lowest among these institutions. Gen Z's 'YOLO' image doesn't match its bank account: Where young Indians are actually spending their salaries. Gen Z's budget is far more practical than flashy. A staggering 70 percent of a young professional's monthly budget is swallowed up by just five core categories , Bills, subscriptions and more 21.55 lakh inoperative EPF accounts have average balance of around rupees 40,000: Check if your EPF money is also stuck; here's what you can do. EPFO member alert: Over the past four years, inoperative Employees Provident Fund accounts have surged by eighty-four percent, with inactive balances witnessing a dramatic increase of one hundred sixteen percent. Furthermore, the average amount in these dormant accounts rose by sixteen percent. This trend indicates that many members are neglecting to file their claims after leaving service. To address this, the government is implementing steps to identify and revive these inactive accounts. DA hike: Minimum pension, variable DA, EPF ceiling increases , Trade union BMS to hold demonstrations on 17 August. Trade union, the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh (BMS), said it will hold nationwide demonstrations on 17 August over long-pending workers' issues. Demands include Minimum pension, variable DA, and EPF ceiling increase. Maharashtra Ladki Bahin Yojana instalment date: When will you receive this month's rupees 1,500 payment?. The Maharashtra government may provide rupees 3,000 to women enrolled in the Ladki Bahin scheme before Raksha Bandhan. However, beneficiaries await clarity on pending payments for July and August, with no official confirmation yet on the potential combined instalment or payment dates. Got Income Tax notice asking you to pay rupees 6,000 in tax? Check this warning from government's fact check team. Attention taxpayers: a fraudulent Income Tax notice demanding a payment of rupees 6,000 has been detected online. The Fact Check team from the Press Information Bureau has categorically identified it as a phishing scam. Citizens are strongly advised not to respond to such deceptive messages from unfamiliar sources. Remember, the Income Tax Department will never ask for sensitive financial details via email. Think your child's PPF is a separate rupees 1.5 lakh limit? Here's what the Kerala HC says. Among the safest investment options in India, public provident fund or PPF investment can help parents prepare for the big expenses in your children's future, be it health, marriage, education or other aspirations. NRI used NRE account to buy rupees 79 lakh property, got 'unexplained cash' tax notice; ITAT Ahmedabad grants full relief. NRI used money from his NRE bank a/c to buy property for rupees 79 lakh, files no ITR; tax dept sent notice for unexplained cash; he wins case in ITAT Ahmedabad Earning money isn't the same as financial freedom, especially for women , Here's why. The ET report said that building long-term wealth requires a deep understanding of financial planning. rupees 4 crore a year for 'exclusive' content: Indian influencers strike gold with paid Instagram subscription.
